How are you?|Perrin Fertha and Sordo|audio=Fertha-Sordo-Reprobate-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Sordo''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was partner of the human female [[Squidna]]. In [[4 BBY]], they attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]], the latter of who was daughter of Sordo's nephew [[Perrin Fertha]] and his [[Marriage|wife]] [[Mon Mothma]]. Fertha and Mon greeted Sordo and Squidna when they arrived at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]], and, at a party later that night, the couple spoke to the bride and groom. On the second [[Local day|day]] of the wedding, Sordo watched Fertha give a wedding speech at [[Foodstuff|dinner]], and, on the third day, the uncle observed the wedding ceremony in one of the estate's courtyards and the first dance in the estate's ballroom. ==Biography== ===Wedding arrival=== {{Quote|So, what do you think, Perrin? Wait for them here or… get a head start on the bar?''"
"''Well, I think the bar. Don't you?|Sordo and Perrin Fertha|audio=Sordo-Fertha-BarHeadstart-OneYearLater.flac|}} [[File:Sordo-Schmoozing-OneYearLater.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Leida Mothma and Stekan Sculdun schmooze Sordo and Squidna during a party at their wedding.|Sordo and Squidna attended the wedding of Leida Mothma and Stekan Sculdun.]] Sordo was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was partner to the human female [[Squidna]] and uncle to [[Perrin Fertha]], a [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]]{{Databank|chandrila|Chandrila}} [[Chandrila]]. In [[4 BBY]], Sordo and Squidna attended the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of Fertha and his [[Marriage|wife]]{{Andor|Harvest}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Mothma family|daughter]], [[Leida Mothma]], and fellow [[Chandrilan]] [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on Chandrila. After arriving in an [[airspeeder]] on the first day, Sordo and Squidna were greeted by Mon and Fertha, the latter of whom Sordo handed a gift and called their favorite nephew. In return, Fertha called Sordo his favorite reprobate and the group then headed further into the estate. Mon's [[Aide|assistant]] [[Erskin Semaj]] then approached to discuss a parking problem with her. Fertha briefly joined their conversation before Sordo asked him if they should wait for others to arrive or head to the bar, while Mon departed. Fertha suggested they head for the bar. Later that [[Standard day|night]] at a party inside one of the estate's small courtyards, Sordo and Squidna spoke with Leida and Sculdun. The bride and groom schmoozed the older couple as Fertha and Stekan's [[Sculdun family|father]], [[Davo Sculdun]], watched. ===Three-day festivities=== {{Quote|Mon, we'll see you. Come on, Sordo.''"
"''Yes, I'm coming.|Squidna and Sordo|audio=Squidna-Sordo-Harvest.flac|{{Andor|Harvest}}}} [[File:Sordo-Speech-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Sordo, Leida Mothma, Mon Mothma, and Squidna listen to Perrin Fertha give a wedding speech while seated along a table at the Mothma Estate.|Sordo listened to their nephew Perrin Fertha give a wedding speech.]] On the second day of the wedding, Sordo and Squidna attended the wedding [[Foodstuff|dinner]] on the estate, and Sordo sat beside Fertha, while Squidna sat a few places down beside Mon. Per Chandrilan tradition, Fertha gave a speech from a dais in the center of the room, welcoming the guests in [[Chandrilan (language)|Chandrilan]] and toasting their health before offering advice to the bride and groom. At the end of the speech, Sordo raised their glass along with everyone else present.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} On the third and final day of the wedding, Sordo and Squidna attended the ceremony in one of the estate's courtyards, standing together on an outer circle with other family members. The couple observed the bride and groom and their parents in the courtyard's central circle as they carried out a ritual in which Stekan cut a braid of Leida's [[hair]]. After the ceremony, Sordo and Squidna gathered with the other guests in the estate's ballroom{{Andor|Harvest}} {{AD|Disney+}} to receive the newly married couple, tapping their [[glass]]es as Leida and Sculdun passed by. The crowd then watched Davo unveil his wedding gift to the newlyweds, a [[Chandi Merle]] statue. When Davo finished a speech about the statue, Sodro tapped a glass and cried "teema" with the rest of the crowd. [[File:Sordo-ThirdDay-Harvest.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=|Sordo was present for all three days of the wedding.]] At drinks afterward, Sordo and Squidna spoke with Mon until her business partner [[Tay Kolma]] approached, at which point Squidna led Sordo away. Soon after, Sordo and Squidna watched Leida and Stekan perform their first dance after which the guests mingled. A [[speaker droid]] then entered the room and began playing [[music]] for the guests to dance to. ==Personality and traits== Sordo had light skin and [[Color|gray]] hair. Fertha considered his uncle a reprobate, and Sordo was happy to get a head start on the bar when arriving at the wedding. ==Equipment== {{Quote|That's for you.''"
"''And what's this?''"
"''Good stuff, this.|Sordo gives a gift to Perrin Fertha|audio=Sordo-Fertha-Gift-OneYearLater.flac|}} [[File:Sordo-Greeting-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Sordo, in purple and grey robes, and Squidna greet Perrin Fertha and Mon Mothma upon arriving at the Mothma Estate.|Sordo bought a gift to the wedding.]] On the first day of the wedding, Sordo wore gray, purple, and white [[Clothing|robes]], changing to golden, brown, and white robes on the second day and brown and white robes on the third. Upon arriving at the Mothma Estate in a cyan airspeeder, Sordo gave Fertha a gift in a golden cross-shaped box with metallic decorations and described it as "good stuff." ==Behind the scenes== Sordo was portrayed by [[Jonathan Coy]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the season's first three episodes, "[[One Year Later]]," "[[Sagrona Teema]]," and "[[Harvest]]," all of which were released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The scene in which Sordo is introduced was filmed as a "oner" and was the final visual effects shot filmed for the season, completed in collaboration between [[Industrial Light & Magic]] and [[Scanline VFX]] on [[August 5]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Sordo|imagecat=Images of Sordo}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/2025-emmy-award-winners-andor|text=''Andor'' Wins Four Creative Arts Emmy® Awards}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Sordo |ja=ソード |ka=სორდო }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
